content.text: {"statements":["In NVIDIA's fiscal year 2026, sales to one direct customer represented 22% of NVIDIA's total revenue.","In NVIDIA's fiscal year 2026, sales to another direct customer represented 14% of NVIDIA's total revenue.","The sales to both of NVIDIA's two largest direct customers in fiscal year 2026 were primarily attributable to the Compute & Networking segment.","Together, NVIDIA's two largest direct customers accounted for 36% of NVIDIA's total revenue in fiscal year 2026.","The 36% figure is the sum of the 22% and 14% stated percentages."]}
